title: Omnipotence of God
definition: The omnipotence of God means that God is all-powerful and able to do all His holy will.
summary: God has unlimited power to accomplish His purposes.
christFocus: Jesus displays divine power over creation, sickness, demons, sin, death, and the grave.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's omnipotence means He has all power. Nothing can overpower Him, frustrate His final purposes, or force Him to act against His nature.

God's power is always holy, wise, and good. He can do all His will, but He cannot lie, sin, deny Himself, or act contrary to His perfect character.

The power of God is revealed in creation, providence, judgment, resurrection, and salvation. In Christ, believers see power used not for pride but for redemption.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often feel trapped by problems, enemies, weakness, or impossible situations. The omnipotence of God matters because no circumstance is stronger than the Lord.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Bring impossible burdens to God in prayer. Trust His power without demanding that He use it according to your timetable. Let His strength give courage for obedience.
